sentences.text:
Author: M.Satyanarayana Murthy
Bench: M.Satyanarayana Murthy
 The Hon'Ble Sri Justice M.Satyanarayana Murthy
 Criminal Petition No.6098 of 2020
Order:

This criminal petition is filed under Section 482 of Criminal Procedure Code (for short "Cr.P.C.") to quash the proceedings in FIR.No.423 of 2020, dated 14.12.2020 on the file of Badvel (U/G) Police Station, YSR Kadapa District, registered for the offences punishable under Sections 188, 272, 273 read with 34 of Indian Penal Code (for short "I.P.C.") and under Sections 57, 58 of Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 (for short "FSS Act").

Learned counsel for the petitioners and the learned Public Prosecutor for the State of Andhra Pradesh submit that the issue involved in this petition is squarely covered by the order of this Court in Criminal Petition No.3731 of 2018 and batch dated 27.08.2018.

In view of the submission of the learned counsel for the petitioners and the learned Public Prosecutor for the State of Andhra Pradesh, this criminal petition also stands allowed in terms of the said order.
Consequently, miscellaneous applications, pending if any, shall stand closed.
The Registry is directed to attach a copy of the order in Crl.P.No.3731 of 2018 and batch dated 27.08.2018 to this order.

_ JUSTICE M. SATYANARAYANA MURTHY Date : 28.12.2020 Gvl HON'BLE SRI JUSTICE M. SATYANARAYANA MURTHY CRIMINAL PETITION No.6098 of 2020 Date : 28.12.2020 Gvl Manuganta Dasaratha Ramarao vs The State Of Andhra Pradesh on 28 December, 2020 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/26748746/
